name: TestcaseClass
summary: Groups test methods into a class the framework can find and run, so that tests have somewhere to live and something to share.

roles.name: TestcaseClass
roles.summary: The class the test methods belong to. It is what a runner discovers, what a fixture is set up for, and what the three organisations of chapter 24 are three different answers about — so a codebase that annotates its testcase classes can then be asked which of the three each one follows.
